scope.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of a session bias after price has moved away from VWAP to at least the first, preferably the second, standard-deviation band, then broken back through and retested that band. The example given is a long: after building volume below and pushing away from fair value, enter once
scope.exit_summary: Use the second and third VWAP standard-deviation bands as profit targets. The setup is presented as a continuation trade after the retest, with those outer bands serving as target levels.
scope.name: vwap_trend_continuation_retest
